d: The pressure is on at Orange County Choppers as the crew races to complete the New York State Police Academy tribute bike. But just when the custom chopper enters its final assembly stage, a major rear fender fitting issue threatens the entire build. With expensive paintwork at risk and the unveiling ceremony fast approaching, Senior and Junior find themselves in a heated confrontation. Can the OCC team fix the problem and deliver the finished motorcycle on time? Watch American Chopper Season 2 Episode 38 and experience the drama behind this custom motorcycle build, only on discovery+ India.
